name: 3-3:Central Control
short:
Find the
control room
to the
underground
facility!
long:
Client: Principal
Quest:
 There must be some
 sort of central control
 room to the underground
 facility. Try to find it.
※ Job can be joined
 while in progress.

Thank you for coming,
<name hero>.

As you well know, we're
still under attack by
those hostile machines

in the mines of that
underground facility.

We still don't know who
built them, or why they
keep attacking us!

We think there's got to
be some sort of central
control room there.

If we find it, maybe
we'll get some answers.

I need hunters like you
in order to seek it out
and find it.

We can't afford to dally.
Time is of the essence!

As always, Irene can give
you the details.
...I'm counting on you.

Please speak to Irene,
my secretary.
Rico...!
N...no, it's nothing.

Please, continue your
investigation.

You think you made it to
what you believe is the
main computer?

There are so many strange
things going on, here.

I'm responsible for over
30,000 lives here on
Pioneer 2.

Should we just give up,
and leave Ragol now,
before it's too late?

But there's no other
planet to settle on.
We need a home...
Splendid, as always.

Please accept a <color 4>reward<color 4>
for your accomplishments.

Speak to Irene. She'll
give it to you.

I'll keep you in mind for
future jobs, as well.

I look forward to seeing
more of your skill in
action.

Speak to Irene to receive
your <color 4>reward<color 0>.
Please, go and rest.

I will bring the matters
of this case up before
the governing council.

Where do you think you're
going?

You haven't spoken with
Irene for the details,
yet!

Here are the mission
details.

Your orders are to search
the facility for a 
central control room.

A teleporter has already
been set up for this
purpose.

You can go down to the
mines directly from the
city.

The mines are still full
of those mechanical
enemies, though.

Be on your guard as you
search for the central
control room.
That's it.
Good luck.
Oh, also...

As for the Principal's
daughter, Red Ring Rico:

If you hear anything 
about her whereabouts,
please let me know.
Thank you.

Red Ring Rico is the
Principal's daughter.
I hope she's safe…

The Principal is waiting.
Please give him your
report.
Great work, as always.

Here. Let me give you
this <color 4>reward item<color 0>.

I hope that you're able
to make good use of it!

We can't find any trace
of the people from
Pioneer 1, or Rico.

We still don't know what
the state of the Central
Dome is, monsters keep

appearing everywhere, and
we can't let the citizens
of Pioneer 2 know!

They would panic if they
knew. The citizens are
uneasy enough as it is!

We need to find a planet
that we can settle on.

Why don't you go and rest
up a bit, for now?

You have already
finished this request.

Please select "Cancel"
at the Counter to
return to the Lobby.

Oh, you're already
carrying too many items,
it seems.

Please come back when you
have some more room.
You received <color 4>reward item<color 0>!

After analyzing the data
on those mechanized
foes you fought,

I now know they contain
Pioneer 1 technology, but
they've been remodeled...

Now, it's someone else's
job to discover exactly
how they got this way.
But...

I'm scared. I fear for
our lives.

Everything, down to the
main system went berserk,
and attacked, huh?

These incidents just keep
defying common sense!

Was there a hidden motive
behind the Pioneer
Project?

Pioneer 1 machines
remodeled to attack us...

Don't you think that this
is some kind of warning?

Now we know for sure that
Ragol is far too
dangerous to settle on.

And the people of Pioneer
1 are all dead!

We've got to get as far
away from this planet as
we possibly can, now!
